result: Most of the time I operate through a largely unified body, a single present scene, and some degree of witnessing, much as other people mostly do. Perfectly independent finger-flows and a cloud of separate colors would not help much with using a shovel. What differs from before, though, is that I no longer take this unified sense of self to be anything more than a poor approximation of reality. Nature assembled it for survival purposes, so that life could reproduce, and so on. I understand that now.
